description: This file defines a Java class 'CaffeineCache' that implements a cache backed by the Caffeine library, providing methods for cache operations such as get, put, invalidate, and cache size metrics.

classes.name: CaffeineCache
classes.description: A generic cache implementation using Caffeine, supporting asynchronous and synchronous cache operations, with optional metrics collection.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory methods to create instances of CaffeineCache with various configurations, including with or without a cache name and with custom loaders.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value asynchronously from the cache, returning an Optional.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value asynchronously using a mapping function if the key is absent.

methods.name: getIfPresent
methods.description: Retrieves a value asynchronously if present, otherwise returns empty.

methods.name: getBlocking
methods.description: Retrieves a value synchronously, blocking if necessary.

methods.name: invalidate
methods.description: Invalidates a cache entry by key, updates metrics if enabled.

methods.name: invalidateAll
methods.description: Invalidates multiple cache entries in batch.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Inserts or updates a cache entry.

methods.name: asMap
methods.description: Returns a view of the cache as a concurrent map.
